papers.title: Immersive Virtual Reality Exergaming vs Video-Guided Screen-Based Exercise for Cognitive and Neurophysiological Adaptations in Young Adults: Protocol for Acute and Chronic Experimental Studies.
papers.reason: This protocol directly targets inhibitory control with Stroop performance and frontal theta EEG, but it is an intervention design with no results yet.

papers.title: Dynamic Brain Network Transitions and Sensorimotor Performance Across the Adult Lifespan.
papers.reason: The title suggests human brain network dynamics and lifespan performance, but the focus appears to be sensorimotor performance rather than executive function, planning, working memory, or attention.

papers.title: Prefrontal transcranial direct current stimulation combined with cognitive training reduces anxiety, daytime sleepiness, and cognitive complaints in women after COVID-19: A randomized, double-blind, sham-controlled trial.
papers.reason: This human trial links left prefrontal stimulation and cognitive training to cognitive outcomes and prefrontal EEG markers, though executive function modelling is not central.

papers.title: Under-recognized Autoimmune Encephalitis in Patients with Alzheimer's Disease: A Case Series Emphasizing EEG Screening.
papers.reason: This appears relevant to clinical cognitive screening with EEG in Alzheimer's disease but has no clear focus on executive function, computational modelling, or task-based assessment.

papers.title: Working memory capacity is linked to directed exploration: behavioral, computational, and electrophysiological evidence
papers.reason: The paper centrally links human working memory capacity to directed exploration using behavioral, computational, and electrophysiological evidence, making it a direct match to executive-function modelling.

papers.title: Transcriptional and DNA Methylation Changes in the Hippocampus and Prefrontal Cortex after Fractionated Cranial Radiation in Mice
papers.reason: Although it studies animal hippocampal and prefrontal biology relevant to brain injury, it does not directly address planning, working memory, attention, cognitive control, or cognitive assessment.

papers.title: Temporal Dynamics of Multi-Item Working Memory Maintenance in Human Gaze Patterns and EEG
papers.reason: The paper directly reports human eye-tracking and EEG findings on multi-item working memory maintenance and attentional prioritization, with clear value for computational models of working memory.

papers.title: Alpha–beta oscillatory dynamics underlying auditory inhibitory control in children
papers.reason: The study provides direct MEG evidence on oscillatory mechanisms of inhibitory control across development, a core executive-function process relevant to cognitive control models.

papers.title: Phase-specific stimulation of prefrontal beta oscillations modulates distinct cognitive processes
papers.reason: The paper gives causal EEG-guided rTMS evidence that prefrontal beta phase differentially modulates working memory and response inhibition, directly informing neural models of executive function.

papers.title: A shared slowing axis and phenotype-specific rhythms link clinical EEG to FDG-PET dementia phenotypes
papers.reason: The paper develops EEG-based clinical phenotyping and classification for dementia subtypes with links to neuropsychological performance including executive function, making it relevant to digital biomarkers of cognitive impairment.
